content: श्लेषः [श्लिष्-घञ्] .²1 An embrace. .²2 Clinging or adhering to. .²3 Union, junction, contact; निरन्तरश्लेषघनाः <ls>K.</ls> (where it has the next sense also). .²4 Pun, paronomasia, {%double entendre%}, susceptibility of a word or sentence to yield two or more interpretations (regarded as a figure of speech and very commonly used by poets; for <ab>def.</ab> see <ls>K. P. Kārikas 84 and 96</ls>); आश्लेषि न श्लेषकवेर्भवत्याः श्लोकद्वयार्थः सुधिया मया किम् <ls>N. 3. 69</ls>; see शब्दश्लेष also. .²5 Burning. .²6 Sexual union; ततो गर्भः संभवति श्लेषात् स्त्रीपुंसयोर्नृप <ls>Mb. 13. 111. 30</ls>. .²7 A grammatical augment.
